exposure: Timing of discharge after cesarean delivery (POD 3 vs POD 4)
cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery between 2013 and 2016
finding: Early discharge after cesarean delivery (POD 3) was not associated with an increased risk of re-admission or postpartum complications compared to later discharge (POD 4).
mod_finding: Early discharge after cesarean delivery (POD 3) was found to be as safe as a more delayed discharge (POD 4) in terms of re-admission rates and postpartum complications.
